# FileX tools

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_tool_docs.py from the tool registry. Do not edit. -->

Every job may also fail with one of the common error codes: `ENGINE_FAILED`, `ENGINE_MEMORY`, `ENGINE_TIMEOUT`, `INPUT_MISSING`, `INVALID_INPUT`, `INVALID_OPTIONS`, `INVALID_OUTPUT`, `OUTPUT_TOO_LARGE`, `SANDBOX_FAILED`, `SECRET_UNAVAILABLE`, `TOOL_UNAVAILABLE`, `WORKER_LOST`. The API contract is [api/openapi.json](api/openapi.json).

## Convert to any format (`convert`)

FileX picks the route over the converters below (ADR-0005): the cheapest chain of at most 4 steps among the workers online now, possibly across profiles. Each step runs with its tool's default options; every lossy step adds a `LOSSY_STEP` warning.

- Preview: `GET /api/v1/convert/plan?from=<format>&to=<format>`; reachable pairs: `GET /api/v1/convert/targets`
- Route: `POST /api/v1/convert/jobs` with `files` and a `target` part
- No route: `422 NO_ROUTE`, `details.profiles` names the profiles that would create one

## Convert

### Images to PDF (`image.to-pdf`)

Turn photos, scans and pictures into a PDF, one file for all or one per image.

- Route: `POST /api/v1/tools/image.to-pdf/jobs`
- Profile: `core`
- Input: `bmp`, `gif`, `heic`, `jpg`, `png`, `tiff`, `webp`, 1 to 200 files
- Output: `pdf`
- Target: the `target` part, one of the outputs (required unless the inputs convert to one format only)
- Keywords: jpg, jpeg, png, heic, photo, picture, scan, tiff, webp
- Warnings: none
- Errors: `TOO_MANY_PAGES`

| Option | Title | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mode` | Output | one of `combine` (One PDF for all images), `each` (One PDF per image) | `"combine"` |
| `pageSize` | Page size | one of `image` (Same size as the image), `a4`, `letter`, `legal`, `a3`, `a5` | `"image"` |
| `orientation` | Orientation | one of `auto` (Match each image), `portrait`, `landscape` | `"auto"` |
| `fit` | Fit on the page | one of `fit` (Fit inside the page), `fill` (Fill the page), `shrink` (Shrink only) | `"fit"` |
| `marginMm` | Margin (mm) | integer 0..50 | `0` |

## Ocr

### OCR (searchable PDF) (`ocr.pdf`)

Recognise the text in scans and photos so the PDF can be searched and copied.

- Route: `POST /api/v1/tools/ocr.pdf/jobs`
- Profile: `ocr`
- Input: `bmp`, `gif`, `jpg`, `pdf`, `png`, `tiff`, `webp`, 1 to 50, each processed on its own files
- Output: `pdf`, `txt`
- Keywords: ocr, searchable, recognize, tesseract, scan, text, pdfa, copy
- Warnings: `INPUT_REPAIRED`, `PDFA_FAILED`, `RESTRICTIONS_REMOVED`, `TEXT_PAGES_SKIPPED`
- Errors: `ENCRYPTED_PDF`, `INVALID_PDF`, `SIGNED_PDF`, `TOO_MANY_PAGES`

| Option | Title | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `languages` | Languages (for example eng or eng+rus) | string, max 100 characters | `"eng"` |
| `mode` | Pages that already have text | one of `skip` (Skip them), `redo` (Redo old OCR), `force` (Force OCR) | `"skip"` |
| `deskew` | Straighten crooked pages | boolean | `false` |
| `rotatePages` | Turn pages the right way up | boolean | `false` |
| `clean` | Clean the scan before reading (page stays as it is) | boolean | `false` |
| `output` | Output | one of `pdf`, `pdfa` (PDF/A-2b) | `"pdf"` |
| `optimize` | Optimize images | one of `none` (Off), `lossless`, `lossy` (Smaller), `strong` (Smallest) | `"lossless"` |
| `sidecar` | Also give me the text as a .txt file | boolean | `false` |

### Clean up scans (`scan.clean`)

Straighten and turn pages, remove specks, black borders and blank pages, optionally add OCR.

- Route: `POST /api/v1/tools/scan.clean/jobs`
- Profile: `ocr`
- Input: `bmp`, `gif`, `jpg`, `pdf`, `png`, `tiff`, `webp`, 1 to 50, each processed on its own files
- Output: `pdf`
- Keywords: deskew, straighten, rotate, blank, border, clean, scan, unpaper
- Warnings: `BLANK_PAGES_REMOVED`, `INPUT_REPAIRED`, `RESTRICTIONS_REMOVED`, `TEXT_PAGES_SKIPPED`
- Errors: `ALL_PAGES_BLANK`, `ENCRYPTED_PDF`, `INVALID_PDF`, `SIGNED_PDF`, `TOO_MANY_PAGES`

| Option | Title | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `deskew` | Straighten crooked pages | boolean | `true` |
| `rotatePages` | Turn pages the right way up | boolean | `true` |
| `clean` | Remove specks and black scanner borders | boolean | `true` |
| `removeBlank` | Remove blank pages | boolean | `true` |
| `ocr` | Make the text searchable (OCR) | boolean | `false` |
| `languages` | Languages for OCR and page direction (for example eng or eng+rus) | string, max 100 characters | `"eng"` |

## Security

### Create signing certificate (`cert.create`)

Make a self-signed certificate for signing PDFs, as a .p12 file locked with your passphrase. FileX keeps no copy of the key.

- Route: `POST /api/v1/tools/cert.create/jobs`
- Profile: `core`
- Input: none, 0 files
- Output: `p12`
- Keywords: certificate, p12, pfx, pkcs12, self-signed, key, signature
- Warnings: none
- Errors: none

| Option | Title | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `commonName` | Your name (shown as the signer) | string, max 64 characters | required |
| `organization` | Organisation | string, max 64 characters | `""` |
| `email` | Email | string, max 128 characters | `""` |
| `keyType` | Key type | one of `rsa-3072` (RSA 3072), `ecdsa-p256` (ECDSA P-256) | `"rsa-3072"` |
| `validityDays` | Valid for (days) | integer 1..3650 | `365` |
| `passphrase` | Passphrase for the .p12 (at least 12 characters) | secret | required |

- Errors: `ENCRYPTED_PDF`, `INVALID_PDF`, `TOO_MANY_PAGES`

| Option | Title | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `userPassword` | Password to open the file | secret | `null` |
| `ownerPassword` | Password to change permissions (blank: none can) | secret | `null` |
| `allowPrint` | Allow printing | boolean | `true` |
| `allowCopy` | Allow copying text and images | boolean | `true` |
| `allowModify` | Allow editing, comments, forms and page changes | boolean | `true` |

### Remove PDF metadata (`pdf.metadata-strip`)

Strip the author, dates, XMP, attachments and scripts hidden in a PDF. What the pages show stays: that needs redaction.

- Route: `POST /api/v1/tools/pdf.metadata-strip/jobs`
- Profile: `core`
- Input: `pdf`, 1 to 50, each processed on its own files
- Output: `pdf`
- Keywords: scrub, privacy, anonymize, clean, metadata, xmp, hidden
- Warnings: `INPUT_REPAIRED`, `RESTRICTIONS_REMOVED`
- Errors: `ENCRYPTED_PDF`, `INVALID_PDF`, `SIGNED_PDF`, `STRIP_INCOMPLETE`, `TOO_MANY_PAGES`

| Option | Title | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `removeComments` | Also remove comments and other annotations (links and form fields stay) | boolean | `false` |

### Sign PDF (`pdf.sign`)

Sign a PDF with your own .p12 certificate (PAdES, no timestamp), invisibly or with a visible stamp. FileX keeps no keys: the .p12 is deleted when the step ends, but while it runs another compromised step on the server could read it.

- Route: `POST /api/v1/tools/pdf.sign/jobs`
- Profile: `core`
- Input: `pdf`, 1 to 20, each processed on its own files
- Output: `pdf`
- Keywords: signature, esign, digital, pades, certificate, p12, pfx
- Auxiliary file `certificate`: Certificate (.p12) (`p12`)
- Auxiliary file `stamp`: Stamp image (`jpg`, `png`, optional)
- Warnings: `ALREADY_SIGNED`, `INPUT_REPAIRED`
- Errors: `CERTIFICATE_EXPIRED`, `ENCRYPTED_PDF`, `INVALID_CERTIFICATE`, `INVALID_PDF`, `SIGNING_LOCKED`, `TOO_MANY_PAGES`, `UNSUPPORTED_KEY`, `UNSUPPORTED_TEXT`, `WRONG_PASSPHRASE`

| Option | Title | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `passphrase` | Certificate passphrase | secret | `null` |
| `reason` | Reason | string, max 200 characters | `""` |
| `location` | Location | string, max 200 characters | `""` |
| `visible` | Show a signature stamp on the page | boolean | `false` |
| `page` | Stamp page (0 = last page) | integer 0..100000 | `1` |
| `position` | Stamp position | one of `top-left` (Top left), `top-center` (Top centre), `top-right` (Top right), `middle-left` (Middle left), `center` (Centre), `middle-right` (Middle right), `bottom-left` (Bottom left), `bottom-center` (Bottom centre), `bottom-right` (Bottom right) | `"bottom-right"` |
